name: ChemDoodle Web Components
tierReason: Primarily a JavaScript component library for embedding chemical sketchers and molecular graphics in applications.
summary: JavaScript components for embedding chemical structure drawing, molecular visualization, and chemistry interfaces in websites.

license.text: GPLv3 library; separate proprietary licenses available.

price.text: Free under GPLv3; proprietary licensing by quote (2026-11-05).

engine.rendering: HTML5 Canvas 2D; WebGL for 3D; canvas2svg for proprietary SVG export
engine.chemistry: ChemDoodle informatics; optional ChemDoodle Java API through iChemLabs Cloud Services
engine.ui: Custom JavaScript/HTML/CSS UI in the ChemDoodleWeb-uis extension
